name: GuaranteedFishHook
description: Guarantees a configurable item (default: Fish Hook) exactly once in the shop of a configurable wave (default: wave 5). Configurable in-game via dami-ModOptions.

enabled.description: Master switch. Set false to disable without uninstalling.

wave.description: Wave whose shop gets the guaranteed item (the shop shown after that wave). Used when 'waves' is empty.

waves.description: If non-empty, list of waves, e.g. [3, 5, 10]. Overrides 'wave'.

item_id.description: Any item id, e.g. item_medikit, item_mirror. item_fish_hook needs the Abyssal Terrors DLC.

slot.description: Which shop slot to use: first, last, random (any slot, incl. weapons), first_item, last_item, random_item (item slots only).

apply_shop_modifiers.description: Run the forced item through the game's shop modifiers (Goldfish tier bump, curse chance, DLC effects), like a natural offer.

force_once_per_wave.description: If true, the item is forced only into the first shop roll of the wave (not re-forced on rerolls) and always appears in exactly one slot.
